text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The afternoon rays of the early summer
sun are shining through my
office window.
Just as I'm about to clock out for the day,
the door
opens.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is now a good moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entering through the door is my trainee,
Mejiro Bright. If I recall, she
couldn't make
it today because of some family matters...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In fact, I'm currently waiting for an
escort from the family
manor to come pick
me up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, would it be okay if I
waited here in your office?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well then, don't
mind me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We've completely entered summer,
haven't we? Our next day off is
sure to be
perfect amusement park weather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The other day, Father sent me
tickets...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue idly chatting for a while. It
feels nice to pass the time
together like
this, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They are, aren't they? Still, I consider
myself rather skilled at whiling
away the
hours, so I think I'll wait for a little while
longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but you get off work early today,
don't you? Will you be leaving
this office?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I do clock out earlier on days we
don't train. But I'm not
about to kick out
Bright and leave her all alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate it. Teehee, this reminds me of
back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Last winter, we also whiled away the time
together like this, just the
two of us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, when you're by my side, I feel as
if...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I become even more carefree than I usually
am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: DING-DONG, BING-BONG...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Oh, my... Has the sun already
begun to set?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forget clocking out early, at this point I'm
going to start accumulating
overtime
hours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it is rather rare for a Mejiro driver to
be even more laid-back
than myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall call them to check—Oh? The screen
has gone all dark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She plugs in her phone to charge. After
some time, the smartphone
lights up to
show a few missed calls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Driver
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me, Miss Bright. Due to
unexpected circumstances, today's
plans
have been postponed to a later date."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Driver
text_block_list.text:
"My sincerest apologies, but you will no
longer be required to leave
the academy
grounds..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...My, this message is from three hours ago.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I may have made you wait with me
this whole time in vain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Bright not to worry. After all, I
managed to finish up tomorrow's

paperwork, and it's my fault for not asking
her to check her calls
earlier, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If you're okay with it, then all is well. Still, I may have let myself be a little too relaxed in your office today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That isn't to say conversing with you today
wasn't enjoyable...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee, is that so? Then we'll leave it at
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...But are things really okay as they are?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun has already long set, but I'm glad I
got to spend the day
together with Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a split second, I see her unusually
deep in thought. Thinking
nothing of it, I
walk her back to her dormitory before
clocking out for
the day.
